newsitem.title: USA: Waigel - Tax cuts are important economic stimulus.
newsitem.headline: Waigel - Tax cuts are important economic stimulus.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said Monday that a reduction in German taxes would help his country's economic growth.
Speaking to reporters, Waigel said: "A reduction of tax rates would be an important economic stimulus."
He said Germany need structural reforms in the area of tax legislation, social insurance and labor market practices.

The ruling German government coalition is working on a plan to overhaul Germany's tax system, which includes major tax reductions. Elements of the plan have been fought by the opposition Social Democrats (SPD).
